  "title": "In log lines where CN of a cert is used - replace it with cert's SerialNumber",
  "body": "To reduce the risk of logging sensitive data, we need to edit log lines where we log the CommonName of a certificate and need to replace it with the cert's SerialNumber.\r\n\r\n\r\nHere is a search result pointing to some of these log lines:\r\n  - https://github.com/openservicemesh/osm/search?q=%22with+CN%22&type=code\r\n\r\nAlternatively another way to find these could be: `grep -Iir \"log\\.\" $(find . -name '*.go') | grep -i 'CN' --color | grep '%s'`\r\nAnother search: `grep -Iir \"log\\.\" $(find . -name '*.go') | grep -i 'GetCommonName' --color`\r\n\r\nIt would be good to tweak these log messages and indicate that what we are logging is the certificate's SerialNumber. With this context we can reference it to other OSM components.\r\n\r\nFor example the message in this log line:  https://github.com/openservicemesh/osm/blob/ee1ce5e6ac4a445d4a4ebc35a1c725b0ba2d43f5/pkg/envoy/ads/stream.go#L160\r\n\r\nShould be changed to `Broadcast update received for certificate with SerialNumber %s`.  For this we would need to use `GetSerialNumber()` from the `Certificater` interface instead of `GetCommonName()`\r\n\r\n> Note: please ensure that all cert issuers have `GetSerialNumber()` properly implemented (vs just a placeholder): https://github.com/openservicemesh/osm/issues/2312",
